items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: And Bix and some in Frankie Trembar, and those boys all came out to Paul's and Monk and Armand Hug and...

ctx.x: but most of the fellas at times I know worked at other jobs. Did Paul start in any other job down here? He was so young before he left home. Did he work at anything then?

Yes, in 1930 he opened a Chicago barbecue here on Magnolia and Washington. And he ran that a few years because I remember Louie visiting there, him and Louie eating all them barbecues. Can we talk about Louie? We mean Louie Armstrong. And any of the musicians that came down visiting, and now you take later on when Paul Whiteman played here. Paul, we all lived out in Metry Ridge then. We had three homes. That was in the early 30s then. And Bix and some in Frankie Trembar, and those boys all came out to Paul's and…
When did he go back to Chicago then?
